decisions.reason: A one-tier arched pyramid is a core Erzgebirge product type with steady seasonal demand, so it stays in the range despite limited recent visibility.
The electronic music box line is the firm's presented flagship and gives it a distinctive niche, so management keeps it, although its distance from the core craft raises the risk of withdrawal.
The motif platform is needed as an accessory for the music box system, but its low prominence makes it a likely target for range trimming.
The Christmas motif platform suits the seasonal focus and supports the music box line, but as a minor accessory it carries substantial risk of being cut.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established craftsmanship and appeals to collectors and tourists, so it is kept.
